title: Todo Create Checklist Permission Consistency

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.todos.update permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing todo create and checklist authorization remain unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing todo and checklist auditing behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The todos route remains readable; only checklist mutation UI is aligned with update authorization.

notes: Todo creation requires fair_crm.todos.create, while checklist replacement requires fair_crm.todos.update. The shared form now exposes, auto-generates, and submits checklist values only when update permission is present, preventing create-only users from creating the Todo successfully and then failing on the secondary checklist mutation.
